en: Vintage sepia postcard with a photograph of an open park scene in Athens, showing the Statue of Byron (Lord Byron) standing on a pedestal, with trees and buildings in the background. In the foreground are two people walking across an open area. The top half of the card is filled with handwritten cursive text, and printed captions in Greek and French appear along the bottom edge, along with a serial number.
